title: Domino: Joint Unmasking via First-order Markov Chain for Few-Step Masked Diffusion
abstract: arXiv:2611.18645v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Masked diffusion models generate a sequence by revealing masked positions over many denoising steps. A few-step sampler has to reveal many positions at once, but the standard reverse kernel draws them independently and primarily ignores the conditional dependence between tokens revealed in the same step. We propose a novel framework called Domino, which models this dependence with a first-order Markov chain over the revealed positions, given the current state. The first revealed position keeps the posterior of a pre-trained masked diffusion model (MDM), and each subsequent position follows a transition given the token of its predecessor. Notably, the resulting step is normalized by construction, contains the factorized step in MDMs as a special case, and has a likelihood in closed form. We implement the Domino transitions via a lightweight module on the hidden states of a pre-trained MDM denoiser with only 2.6% parameter overhead and t

translated_title: Domino：基于一阶马尔可夫链的少步掩码扩散联合去掩码方法
translated_abstract: 掩码扩散模型通过在多个去噪步骤中逐步揭示被掩码的位置来生成序列。少步采样器必须一次揭示许多位置，但标准的反向核对它们是独立抽取的，主要忽略了在同一步骤中揭示的token之间的条件依赖关系。我们提出了一个名为 Domino 的新颖框架，它使用一阶马尔可夫链在给定当前状态的情况下对揭示位置之间的这种依赖关系进行建模。第一个被揭示的位置保留预训练掩码扩散模型（MDM）的后验分布，而每个后续位置则根据其前驱token遵循给定的转移分布。值得注意的是，由此产生的步骤在构造上是归一化的，将 MDM 中的因子化步骤作为特例包含在内，并具有闭式似然。我们通过在预训练 MDM 去噪器的隐藏状态上添加一个轻量级模块来实现 Domino 转移，参数开销仅为2.6%，……
tldr: 提出 Domino 框架，用一阶马尔可夫链建模同一步骤中揭示的 token 之间的条件依赖，仅以 2.6% 的参数开销实现少步掩码扩散的联合去掩码生成。
en_tdlr: Domino models the conditional dependence between tokens revealed in the same step via a first-order Markov chain, enabling joint unmasking for few-step masked diffusion with only 2.6% parameter overhead.
